text: If blockchain pushes settlement finality into the seconds range, the entire regulatory infrastructure built to address counterparty and systemic risk would have to be reformed, and most systemic risk and counterparty risk regulation would become unnecessary.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
abstract: Arguably the entire regulatory infrastructure that has been tailored to address counterparty- and systemic risk would need to be reformed if settlement finality can be increased to the seconds range with blockchain technology.
